mainEntity.name: Is it safe to book a shore excursion outside the cruise line?

acceptedAnswer.text: Absolutely! Thousands of cruise passengers book independent tours in Agadir every year without issues. The key is choosing a reputable local operator with good reviews, confirmed meeting procedures, and guaranteed return times. We've been welcoming cruise passengers for 10+ years with a 100% return rate.

mainEntity.name: How do I know I'll get back to the ship on time?

acceptedAnswer.text: We guarantee return 60-90 minutes before your ship's departure. We know Agadir traffic patterns, we track ship schedules, and we've never had a passenger miss their ship. Your guide will have the ship's departure time confirmed and will manage the itinerary accordingly.

mainEntity.name: What if my cruise ship changes its schedule?

acceptedAnswer.text: We monitor schedule changes and adjust accordingly. If your port time is significantly reduced, we'll offer a modified tour or refund. Your guide will have our contact number for real-time updates.

mainEntity.name: How much money should I bring for a shore excursion?

acceptedAnswer.text: For a guided tour: €40-60 per person (tour cost) + €30-50 for shopping/extras. We accept euros and credit cards. For independent exploring, bring €50-100 in cash plus card backup.

mainEntity.name: What should I wear for a shore excursion in Agadir?

acceptedAnswer.text: Agadir is relaxed—casual, comfortable clothing is fine. For Paradise Valley, bring swimwear and water shoes. For city tours, comfortable walking shoes. Morocco is Muslim but Agadir is tourist-friendly; modest clothing is appreciated but not strictly required.

mainEntity.name: Can I do a shore excursion on my own without a guide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, but we recommend a guide for first-time visitors. Taxis are available at the port, but you'll need to negotiate prices, navigate language barriers, and manage your own timing. A guide provides local knowledge, handles logistics, and ensures you're back on time.

mainEntity.name: Do you offer private shore excursions?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes! Private tours are available for couples, families, or groups. You'll have your own guide and vehicle with a fully customized itinerary. Private tours typically cost €150-250 for 2-4 people (total, not per person).

mainEntity.name: What if I have mobility issues?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most tours can be adapted for limited mobility. Paradise Valley involves some walking on uneven terrain (not suitable for wheelchairs). City tours and beach/camel rides are more accessible. Contact us with your specific needs and we'll advise.

mainEntity.name: How far in advance should I book?

acceptedAnswer.text: We recommend booking 1-2 weeks before your cruise. During peak season (December-March), book earlier to ensure availability. We can sometimes accommodate last-minute bookings via WhatsApp.

mainEntity.name: What's included in your shore excursion prices?

acceptedAnswer.text: All our tours include: port pickup and drop-off, air-conditioned transport, English-speaking guide, entrance fees, and usually lunch. Tips are not included but appreciated.
